tasks.notes: Design: docs/plans/world-cli-arg.md (locked 2026-10-26; landed with the lib split). Remove env AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT entirely (no default, no fallback). tasks.title: Roof edging is a design answer from the aerial, default none
tasks.notes: Problem: feature_build.shell_zoned hard-codes a smooth_stone PARAPET on every zoned roof edge, including zone steps (SUSU rings); roof_flat adds a slab fringe on every flat roof. Spec: one optional roofs[label].edge, absent = no edging; when present {block, where: outer|all} ('outer' skips zone steps). Block is a designer choice. shell_zoned and roof_flat read it; the flat-roof overhang fringe is built only when edge asks for it; pitched overhang unchanged. Validate in load_spec. Process, no new step: add 'edge on the roof? what block? outer or steps too?' to questions the designer already answers from aerial/street level; touch only rules/building-review.md step 3, rules/build-roles.md designer questions, rules/evidence-order.md roof row; fix rules/feature-builds.md:53 and the craftsmanship checklist to say default none. Check bakeoff_r003_susu.json and r015_susu.py against the aerial; set edge only if shown. Tests in lib/builds/test_feature_build.py: default none, bad values refused, outer skips steps, all matches old output. Separate world job: audit built buildings with unevidenced edging.
